geometry_names: Continuous supported spoon bowl and handle_CUT02

corner_order: FBX PolygonVertexIndex order (= Blender loop order of the exported mesh). Each row: corner, polygon, vertex, old UV0, new UV0.
apply_to_native_mesh: 元Codex: map Unity/native corners to these FBX corners via (polygon, vertex) or by the identical Vertices/PolygonVertexIndex hashes in *_uv0_stats.json. If the native mesh was re-indexed/split on import, match by (polygon index, corner position within polygon); do not use vertex index alone (UV0 is per corner and splits at box-projection seams).
